secret.description: a secret the graph names and never holds: written with its value, kept somewhere else, and read back only as [set]

name.description: what a config or a program asks for it by; the entity id is derived from it, so one name is one secret

value.description: written: the value itself; an op:// reference is kept unresolved and supplies no runtime credential. Stored: a random handle retained across rotations. Public graph reads return [set]; trusted native storage reads retain the handle
